_comment: Gemini->Responses contract. One known malformed nested field (parameters and parametersJsonSchema together): rejected pre-IO in both strict and lossy modes.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.respup]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"

[[models]]
name = "gem-resp"
provider = "respup"
model = "gpt-4.1"
name: gemini_to_responses_malformed
